browserBeforeCorrection.status: Superseded browser replay, retained including the failed Firefox independent hat.

browser.criteria: Fresh real image import and Paint free-border controls; actual worker geometry and paper checks; every shared span preserved on both editable SVG sheets; editor crossing checks; protected error <=1% for top hats, <=3% for other free motifs and Hunodan, <=1.5% for star. Star PDF signature checked.

timingRegression.before: Fails: only untouched candidate checkpoint remains after slow initialization.
timingRegression.after: Passes: curve iterations and polishing run within the longer requested budget.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

limits: No global optimum or exact silhouette guarantee.
The protected shape is chosen by the user.
Some easy cases are slower or slightly less accurate; see the small-house paired result.
Soft-border UI and photo-coordinate/crop-uncertainty weights are not included.
No physical cutting or assembly test.
